dct_description_sm: Algeria administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 48 nan - Admin 2: 1541 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 19 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 20 January 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 28 April 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 28 April 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
